decisions.reason: The source changes I2C cable-length and series-resistor guidance, not ESP32-S3 GPIO assignments or compatibility.
The SDA/SCL series-resistor policy does not change the interboard connector types, pinouts, or permitted pin ordering.
The source discusses electrical signal conditioning and layout convenience, not component availability, sourcing, or cost.
Although the source makes the 22Ω SDA/SCL resistors optional, the candidate state contains no corresponding BOM attribute, and the source does not establish a necessary BOM change.
The optional removal of SDA/SCL series resistors does not alter battery-connector placement, orientation, spacing, or mounting-hole clearance.
The phrase about layout difficulty grants flexibility for I2C resistors but does not change any power-board mechanical constraint.
The source concerns SDA/SCL signal conditioning and does not resolve or modify the battery connector's series, mounting type, or pinout.
The I2C electrical guidance does not modify the AXP2101 battery, USB, VMID, or VSYS power-path topology.
The referenced 2.2kΩ pull-ups and optional 22Ω SDA/SCL resistors are unrelated to the 5V rail's enable pull-down, switching behavior, or powered loads.
The source does not change the standalone regulator, source-selection topology, activation condition, or powered load.
Optional physical placement or removal of SDA/SCL resistors does not affect whether the KiCad project and its footprints resolve portably.
The source concerns I2C SDA/SCL conditioning and does not change the addressable LEDs' 5V supply or level-shifter requirement.
